headline: Public hearings on auto shop licenses at 19 Benefit Street and 102 Esten Avenue, and a liquor license transfer at 368 Cottage Street.
summary: The meeting covers public hearings on auto and liquor licenses, including a transfer at 368 Cottage Street. It also covers new and renewal petitions for entertainment, victualling, firearms, pigeon loft, waste hauler, and kennel licenses.
items: Consent agenda (items marked with an asterisk)
